title: Understanding Maximum Height
text: At maximum height, all kinetic energy has converted to potential energy. The ball stops momentarily before falling back down, so v = 0 at this point.

title: Choosing the Right Equation
text: We have: u = 25 m/s (up), v = 0 (at max height), a = -9.8 m/s² (down). We need s (height). The equation v² = u² + 2as contains all these variables.

title: Sign Convention
text: Take upward as positive. Initial velocity is +25 m/s, but gravity acts downward so a = -9.8 m/s².
